notes: G3 spec (target->all on the tap). Printed: '{1}{W}, {T}: Tap TARGET creature. Activate only if you control a creature with flying.' You control a flier, so the ability can be activated, but only with its target: activated without designating one it is refused before its cost is paid (CR 601.2c, 602.2b; activate() refuses an empty designation for a slot that needs a target, as stack.cast refuses a spell's). No creature gets tapped: neither the opponent's two creatures nor your flier, and the {1}{W} stays in the pool. (Until 2026-11-13 activate() validated passed targets only and the engine refused this at resolution, 'TARGET selector has no designation', after the cost was paid.)
